layout.description: 2 columns, 2 rows — 4 items total. Fewest choices; best for 24-28 months or low-difficulty activities. Large items, generous spacing.

metadata.reviewerNotes: All four animals (dog, cat, cow, duck) are among the earliest animal words acquired by toddlers, making this ideal for 24–36 months. The prompt 'Tap the dog!' is 3 words, uses a known action verb, and exactly matches the correct item label as required by the division principles. Item count (1 correct + 3 distractors), difficulty level, grid layout, and targetDurationSeconds all align precisely with the concept brief and low-difficulty tap-to-select spec. One minor flag: the audioRef is a PLACEHOLDER — this must be replaced with a real recorded audio file before the activity goes live, as the division explicitly requires the prompt to play automatically at start.
